row_R5.excerpt: oden crate is worth swinging at before hunting for another way around. [Black Mesa / mechanic: Crossing the electrified waste pools] (trust: fallback_no_source) The waste-treatment area has stretches of standing water with live wiring dropped into it, and the current is constant — there is no safe moment and no warning cycle to wait for. Stepping in deals continuous shock damage until you get out or die, so treat the flooded floor like lava rather than something to time. Cross on anything above the water: desks, cabinets, shelves, floating crates and overhead pipes all work, and the route is usually built into the room once you look
